analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 26 reviews, decent sample but could shift with more data

review_highlights.comment: There are no lecture slides or recordings - he derives equations on a chalkboard the whole time. If you fall behind in this class, it is almost impossible to catch up because you don't even know what topics are being covered (again, no slides). All assignments and tests are online, un-proctored, but still very difficult. Final is 45% of your grade.

DO NOT TAKE THIS GUY. should retire atp, no one would miss him here. don't ask questions because he'll look at you like you're challenged. also changed tests from take home to in class, tests are 26 questions long, final is 45% of the grade. just evil work all throughout. also he's from prague (he'll make sure you know this)

Great guy, less so of a professor, but if having a professor interested in his work pulls you in as well you'd do perfect. Caution though as final is worth 50% of grade and guessing on his exams is next to impossible.

One of the worst professor in UT, he did a terrible job to explain the material and the tests are hard. Final exam take 50% of the whole grade. I won't take him if I have to retake engineer physics one more time.

DO NOT TAKE THIS TEACHER... not only will you not leardn ANYTHING from him but you will also FAIL every single test. he derives equations and then moves on, leaving everyone confused. seems like a smart good guy, but when it comes to teaching, horrible! his tests are very hard(20-24 questions) 1.5 hours. if you dont care about your education and gr

analysis.name: C Tyler Dick
analysis.verdict: Highly rated with a manageable workload, and ratings have been declining
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 10 reviews, decent sample but could shift with more data

review_highlights.comment: I enjoyed the class. Attendance isn't mandatory, but it will count towards your final grade. He was very good at ensuring all students could determine the civil engineering sub-discipline that best fit their interests throughout the class. He is very patient and has a nice personality. I enjoyed the guest lectures thoroughly and the class was easy.

Dr. Dick is a very nice guy. Helped students learn about different disciplines in civil engineering and brought in other profs for guest lectures. There is a lab, but it is not hard as long as you work with your group and listen to the TA's and Dr. Dick's instructions. Emphasis on nice guy, he was probably one of the chillest profs ive had.

Attendance isnt mandatory but he does in-class assignments every class day that counts towards final grade. The labs are easy but the TA's are kind of tough graders for the lab reports. I highly recommend you take ARE217 before this class because you will need to know basics of AutoCAD for some of the projects.

Your grade is basically dependent on your group project! He is very passionate about what he does and encourages students to find their area of interest as well. He is always open to criticism and has a few assignments asking us for our opinions on the class and civil engineering as a whole.

An excellent lecturer who consistently provides valuable feedback to students on projects and helps them develop software skills in MicroStation. Course materials are slides. He is incredibly patient, guiding students through step-by-step calculations in class. If you stay engaged and follow along, you'll definitely succeed.

analysis.name: Dirk Mateer
analysis.verdict: Highly rated with a manageable workload, but ratings have been improving recently
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 47 reviews, fairly reliable

review_highlights.comment: I was dreading taking an economics class—I was a mostly straight A student in high school, but nearly failed macro. I took micro with Dr. Mateer, and honestly, it was one of my favorite classes I've ever taken. He makes lectures fun and engaging with games and activities that demonstrate key economics concepts. I highly recommend! Take this class!

Dirk is the best professor I've had. Fantastic lecturer and a super forgiving grading system (everyone should get A's as long as they show up and try). Don't need to study too much for tests and very engaging in class as he gives out candy for participation & money for kahoot wins. Only downside to this glorious man is his nephew Mateer (OU's QB).

Dirk is friendly and passionate about teaching, but lectures are often inefficient/irrelevant. The textbook has the important content for exams, while in-class “activities” meant to be engaging are a waste of time (ex: donut eating contests). Exams are fair but get harder through the semester. Class attendance is needed for participation points.

Dirk is the GOAT. King made everything easy and he was just so real. Nothing about the course was hard and exams were similar to the Kahoots and the homework. He's funny and always gave out prizes for first in the Kahoots or for participating when he needed volunteers. He bought me a frosty from Wendy's one time and also brought donuts to class.

In-class demos are fun and helpful, attendance is greatly encouraged. He's kind, funny, and understanding. Notes are easy to follow. Tests are very straightforward; he posts a topic list, as well as the number of questions per topic. The extra credit saved me from taking the final. Grade is based off cumulative points earned throughout the class.

analysis.name: Debra Hansen
analysis.verdict: Most students had a tough time. Look into alternatives if you can, and ratings have been declining
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 322 reviews, this is a reliable picture

review_highlights.comment: Lectures are very boring and very confusing. She's very patronizing and will look down upon you if you ask questions she deems stupid. She will rarely directly answer a question, instead she'll pose a new question that'll confuse you even more. You'll basically have to fuse with your textbook in order to do well.I highly regret taking this course.

I'm sitting in hansen's class right now and I wish I hadn't come. She has an incredible ability to not answer a single question, even when asked directly. On top of this, her lectures are confusing and not relevant to the tests. Study the textbooks, go to the TAs (not gustavo), and really know your stuff and you'll be fine, but don't expect help.

This woman ruined my mental state for a solid 8 months. She was a boring lecturer with immensely unfair tests. Do the learning objectives, know them back and forth and hope for the best with the tests. She would overlook huge topics in tests while pinpointing dumb facts. Study more than you need to, and study the lectures before book. Good luck.

Dr. Hansen makes biology very unbearable. It's almost as if she doesn't even know the material herself.  She asks lots of questions in class, and never provides the correct answer, leaving her students very confused.  Not worth your time-- I would honestly recommend taking Bio another semester if she is your only choice.

Worst professor I've ever had at UT. She is HORRIBLE. Her lectures are irrelevant to the tests and she is impossible to please. The tests are filled with mediocre facts that were never mentioned in the reading or lecture. It's impossible to know what to study. Sweet lady, horrible professor.
